notes.title: Putrefaction 2 on Greenlight!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! I am happy to announce that my new game Putrefaction 2 is on Steam Greenlight! This is a sequel to my first game, and I want to make this one right.

The game will be very different and improved experience, compared to first title. It is now much more fast-paced, open and colorful shooter, however it still retains impactful and gory gunplay from original. I am aiming to fix all mistakes I had previously and I hope everyone will enjoy this game even more. 

Please vote for it:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=805837428

notes.title: Early Access version 0.91a. Coming close to full release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New version was just added to the game, with couple of minor bufg fixes, graphical updates and interface improvements.

The game is coming close to full release. I am planning to release it as a full game probably next week.  There still be minor bug fixes and content updates, but none of the game mechanics will change anymore and the gameplay will stay the same.

Envy the Dead has changed and evolved massively for the months it was in Early Access, and I think the moment came, when I don't want to add any major things, because I don't want it to stuck in Early Access for years. Thank you for your support, this community helped the game tremendously to become what it is now.

notes.title: Character update (Warning! Important info)
notes.notes:
New update was just added to the game.

Warning! This update will break your save file, so you'll have to start new campaign and overwrite it. I'm sorry for inconvinience, but this is the nature of Early Access - some things are changing all the time.

What's new:

[list]
    [*]Character system changed, now instead of generic looking people the game will have more unique personalities, that  I think will make characters more memorable and diverse. Later every characters will have own little bio and unique perks. Characters roster will increase over time.
    [*]Character window don't have subpanels anymore, everything is in one place. Also buttons for scrolling lists added.
    [*]Day/Night cycle is returned as optional choice at the start of the game.
    [*]Unlocks changed - now you are unlocking simple stuff after first map completion and more advanced stuff after second map.
   [*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New balance patch
notes.notes:
New patch was added to the game:
[list]
    [*]Day/night cycle is removed from the game. Even though it's adding to the atmosphere of the game, I believe it is unnecessary for the gameplay.
    [*]You are starting with less ammo and receive less ammo in scavenges
    [*]Shield is now adds to the melee weapon, without replacing it. It can only be used with bats and axes, I will add more melee weapons soon
    [*]Crafting is now correctly adds experience to the characters and current craft skill is now sum of maximum skilled character and fraction of other crafting skilled characters
    [*]You can now rotate structures before placing them in battle
    [*]Zombie now spawn in small groups
    [*]A lot of small improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: List of changes in upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Right now I am working on big update for the game, with a lot of base mechanics changed and improved, based of some of the feedback and reactions I received. Right now I am trying to figure out what works better for the game, so in the next weeks expect constant changes.

[list]
    [*]The social system didn't really fit in core gameplay, so after a lot of thinking I decided to cut it out completely and replace it with more meaningful and traditional system.
    [*]Commanders system and unlocks for them are gone too. Now, instead of commanders, every character in group going to have experience, levels, talents and skills to unlock.
    [*] Grid-based battles with pause will be replaced by more free-moving, faster system with a lot of micro-control. Think Warcraft 3, something like that. There will be different types of enemies with unique behaviors and abilities (runners,spitters,jumpers etc.)
  [*] A lot of interface improvements.
[/list]

The update is plannng to release in 10-12 days. Stay tuned and thank you for your support!
